description: Land Acquisition - Meegahahena, Katuwana D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific land parcel (F. V. P. 139) in Meegahahena village for a public purpose. It provides a detailed description of the land, its location, and its contents, and calls for interested parties to submit claims for compensation. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
